description: SFW photoreal preference bake-off: Korean/Indian portraits and one cinematic street shot. Models come from the UI selection (OpenRouter image generators).
notes: Human N-way preference (winner / tie) plus optional vision-LLM auto-judge.
No Krea / NSFW endpoints — SFW prompts only.

prompts.subject: portrait
prompts.prompt: Photorealistic candid photo of a young Korean woman in her mid-20s sitting by a cafe window in Seoul, soft overcast daylight on her face. Straight black hair with soft bangs, fair skin with natural texture and subtle freckles across the nose, brown almond-shaped eyes, small nose, gentle closed-mouth smile. Wearing a cream knit sweater and a thin gold necklace. Shallow depth of field, 50mm lens, natural skin detail, no makeup overload, clearly East Asian Korean features.

prompts.subject: portrait
prompts.prompt: Photorealistic night street portrait of a Korean woman in her early 20s on a busy Hongdae sidewalk. Neon cyan and magenta reflections on her cheeks, shoulder-length dark brown hair slightly windswept, sharp jawline, double eyelids, light natural makeup. Oversized black blazer over a white tee, tote bag on one shoulder. Handheld documentary feel, slight motion in background pedestrians, clearly Korean facial features, SFW fashion photo.

Clean window light from the left, shallow depth of field, LinkedIn-style professional photography, no westernized beauty defaults.
